description: Unique shipment identifier (e.g., SHP-01 to SHP-23 for F1, COMM-01 to COMM-04 for commercial)
validation: Unique, non-null, format SHP-XX or COMM-XX

description: Operational domain classification: F1_Demonstration (stress-test use case) or Commercial_General (commercial freight)
Chronological race-to-race transport leg sequence (1 to 23 for F1; null for commercial general shipments)
Formula 1 championship round number corresponding to the origin Grand Prix (1 to 24 for F1; null for commercial shipments)
Origin city or locality name
Official Formula 1 Grand Prix circuit name (or N/A for commercial shipments)
Logistics hub, cargo terminal, container port, or circuit paddock freight gate at origin
Sovereign country or territory of origin facility/circuit
Origin facility/circuit geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees
Origin facility/circuit geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees
Continental or geopolitical geographic region of origin (e.g., Middle East, Europe, North America, East Asia, Oceania, South America)
Formula 1 championship round number corresponding to the destination Grand Prix (1 to 24 for F1; null for commercial shipments)
Destination city or locality name
Official Formula 1 Grand Prix circuit name (or N/A for commercial shipments)
Logistics hub, cargo terminal, container port, or circuit paddock freight gate at destination
Sovereign country or territory of destination facility/circuit
Destination facility/circuit geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees
Destination facility/circuit geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees
Continental or geopolitical geographic region of destination (e.g., Middle East, Europe, North America, East Asia, Oceania, South America)
As-the-crow-flies straight-line distance calculated between origin and destination coordinates using Haversine formula (Earth radius = 6,371 km)
Gross freight shipment mass in metric tonnes (1,200 t operational baseline for F1; variable 8-650 t for commercial general freight)
Descriptive manifest text of cargo commodity or event infrastructure (e.g., Formula 1 race cars and paddock equipment, consumer electronics, automotive subassemblies)
Bibliographic source citation or benchmark classification for the declared cargo mass
Scheduled freight release and departure timestamp in ISO 8601 calendar date format (Monday 08:00 following previous Grand Prix for F1)
validation: Valid ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD <= delivery_deadline

description: Mandatory delivery deadline timestamp in ISO 8601 calendar date format (Thursday 18:00 setup deadline prior to destination Grand Prix for F1)
validation: Valid ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD >= departure_date

description: Total planning window available for transit and customs handling, calculated as delivery_deadline minus departure_date in decimal days
Informational context, operational itinerary, or testing purpose for the shipment record
Unique transport candidate alternative identifier (e.g. OPT-SHP-01-AIR, OPT-COMM-01-RAIL)
Foreign key referencing the parent shipment in shipments.shipment_id
Operational domain classification inherited from parent shipment: F1_Demonstration or Commercial_General
Candidate transportation mode evaluated for the shipment leg (Air, Road, Rail, Sea)
Physical routing feasibility status determined by geographical and infrastructure connectivity: Feasible, Conditionally Feasible, or Infeasible
Operational explanation and physical infrastructure justification for the feasibility status (e.g., motorway corridor, ocean barrier, Eurotunnel shuttle)
Operational route distance incorporating modal circuity multiplier detour; zero for infeasible modes
Ratio of realistic operational route distance to great-circle distance (Air: 1.08, Road: 1.20-1.30, Rail: 1.25-1.35, Sea: 1.45-1.70); 0.0 for infeasible modes
Total expected freight transit duration including terminal handling buffers and modal operating hours; 0.0 for infeasible modes
Projected destination arrival date calculated as departure_date plus transit_time_days (N/A for infeasible modes)
validation: Valid ISO date YYYY-MM-DD or N/A

description: Boolean flag indicating whether transit_time_days <= shipments.available_window_days; False for infeasible modes
Buffer safety margin calculated as available_window_days minus transit_time_days (positive indicates on-time arrival; negative indicates delay; -999.0 for infeasible modes)
Fixed terminal handling, ULD packing, stevedoring, drayage, and gate fees in USD (fixed_per_tonne * cargo_weight_tonnes); 0 for infeasible modes
Variable ton-kilometer transportation and line-haul haulage fee in USD (rate_per_tonne_km * cargo_weight_tonnes * route_distance_km); 0 for infeasible modes
Total estimated transportation cost in USD, calculated as fixed_cost_usd + distance_cost_usd; 0 for infeasible modes
Official greenhouse gas emission conversion factor per metric tonne-kilometer (Air: 0.6200, Road: 0.1153, Rail: 0.0281, Sea: 0.0116)
Total greenhouse gas emissions in metric tonnes CO2 equivalent: (cargo_weight_tonnes * route_distance_km * factor) / 1000; 0.0 for infeasible modes
Weighted multi-objective decision utility score: 35% Cost + 40% Carbon Emissions + 25% Transit Time across deadline-compliant options; 0.0 for infeasible/excluded modes
Decision flag indicating the optimal recommended alternative meeting deadline and multi-objective criteria; exactly one True per eligible shipment
validation: Boolean (True or False); at most one True per shipment

description: Data confidence classification: Benchmark Assumption (Documented Formula) for F1, Synthetic Benchmark (Commercial Stress Test) for commercial, or Not Applicable for infeasible
validation: In [Benchmark Assumption (Documented Formula), Synthetic Benchmark (Commercial Stress Test), Not Applicable]

description: Financial estimation disclaimer: Illustrative Estimate (Non-commercial Quotation) for feasible options, or Illustrative (Infeasible) for infeasible options
Unique disruption scenario identifier (DIS-01 to DIS-05)
Short descriptive title of the disruption event
Hazard taxonomy classification: Geopolitical / Chokepoint Closure, Weather & Labor Industrial Action, Port / Customs Border Bottleneck, Climate / Waterway Bottleneck, Severe Weather / Cyclone
Primary transportation mode directly impaired by the disruption event (Air, Road, Rail, Sea)
Trade corridor or geographic transit lane subject to the disruption
Estimated transit delay added to affected routes passing through the disrupted corridor in decimal days
Fixed freight surcharge, congestion fee, rerouting fuel burn, or reservation premium in USD added to affected options
Percentage increase in greenhouse gas emissions caused by maritime/air detours, queuing, or low-speed holding patterns
Detailed physical narrative of the disruption mechanism, geographic choke point, and operational impacts
Operational state of the disruption in the scenario evaluation engine (e.g. Simulated Active Scenario)
Operational contingency recommendation, modal alternative, or strategic bypass recommended by GreenGrid
Unique scenario evaluation test case identifier (TC-01 through TC-08)
Operational domain evaluated in the test case: F1_Demonstration or Commercial_General
Descriptive title of the scenario evaluation test case and evaluated shipment lane
Foreign key referencing the target shipment evaluated in this scenario test
Origin city of evaluated shipment leg
Destination city of evaluated shipment leg
Identifier of active disruption scenario evaluated in this test case (DIS-01 to DIS-05, or NONE for clean baseline)
validation: Must exist in disruptions.disruption_id or equal NONE

description: Candidate transport mode directly tested under baseline versus disrupted conditions (Air, Road, Rail, Sea)
Mode label under undisturbed baseline conditions
Expected transit duration under undisturbed baseline conditions in decimal days
Total freight cost under undisturbed baseline conditions in USD
Total greenhouse gas emissions under undisturbed baseline conditions in metric tonnes CO2 equivalent
Boolean flag indicating whether baseline_transit_days <= shipments.available_window_days
Transport mode label reflecting simulated disruption state (e.g. Sea (Disrupted) or Road)
Total transit duration under disruption including delay impact days
Total freight cost under disruption including congestion/rerouting surcharge in USD
Total greenhouse gas emissions under disruption incorporating percentage emissions adjustment in metric tonnes CO2e
Boolean flag indicating whether disrupted_transit_days <= shipments.available_window_days
Actionable decision recommendation generated by GreenGrid (e.g. modal shift, charter dispatch, or schedule adjustment)
Plain-language trade-off justification explaining the operational decision, cost/carbon balance, and deadline compliance
